Name: Easy Fishing Farm
Author: AlyaLyalya
Description:
[size=2]Hello everyone! This is my new farm. It is a replacement for FISHING farm.
[/size][size=2]
So, this map features: 
* Config Options
  - Different Starter Gifts - choose before starting new save file!
  - Layout (if TRUE - [/size][size=2]adds a planning layout for crop fields, sprinklers, fish ponds, ect)

Farming: All tiles should be tillable!
[/size][size=2]Foraging: Berry Bushes, respawning stumps, a little quarry. 
Ranching: start with the blue grass! 
[/size][size=2]Fishing: you can catch a town river fish on the farm.
[/size][size=2]It's safe to pass out on your farm.

[/size][size=2]Compatibility:
Recolors - should work fine.
SVE - I don't play with it but warps to Woods, Forest and Railroad should work, also in SVE mod config you can choose 'Grandpa's Shed' option that moves the warp point off the farm and custom coorditanes for Enchanted Grove Warp. 
Minecarts - this map is shorter then standard vanilla farms and some mods that add minecart on the farm might cause an issue with black void after the right edge of the farm map. If you have it, try choose custom option in those mods if possible. I know that [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21859](CP) More Minecarts[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts - A Minecart Expansion[/url]﻿ have this option. So in configs of those mods choose (x 33 y 6 or whatever you want).
[/size][size=2]make sure you don't have other mods replacing this farm

[/size][size=2]!!! Make sure you don't have other mods replacing FISHING farm !!![i] [/i]

[/size][size=2]Requirements:
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿
 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

How to Install:
Download and then unzip
Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder
Run the game and pick the Fishing Farm

[i]I wish you all the best.
[/i][/size]
